title: Return Codes and Extra Good-Through Days on PracticePay Patient Financing Payoffs
content:
A PracticePay Patient Financing payoff adds extra good-through days when a payment on the plan has recently come back for certain reasons.

**Rule.** The return-reason extra good-through days of a payoff are 3 days when a payment on the plan came back within the last 6 months with return code R02, R03 or R04, 1 day when none did but a payment came back within the last 6 months with return code R01 or R09, and 0 otherwise. Here a window of the last 6 or 12 months covers entries dated fewer than that many whole months before today, a month being whole once today's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Payments that came back on the plan within the last 6 months | Extra good-through days |
|---|---|
| at least one with R02 (account closed), R03 (no account) or R04 (invalid account number) | 3 |
| none with R02, R03 or R04, but at least one with R01 (insufficient funds) or R09 (uncollected funds) | 1 |
| only other codes, or none at all | 0 |


## Cases (hypothetical, payoff on 15 October)

- Returns with R01 on 2 June and R03 on 20 August: an R03 return falls within the window, so 3 extra days.
- A return with R09 on 1 August and an R02 return on 1 March: the R02 return is 7 whole months back and outside the window; the R09 return gives 1 extra day.
- A return with R08 on 1 September only: 0 extra days.
